The integration of histamine with these drugs highlights a possible role in the development or progression of the disease, though the exact mechanism remains to be elucidated. The evidence is strengthened by the presence of overlapping indications and the sequential relationship between histamine and the target syndrome, though further investigation is needed to confirm the direct or indirect therapeutic relevance of histamine in this context.
